title: Spotify for Artists — portrait and linework
slide_intent: Keep artists visibly human while adding a shared graphic frame because professional audiences need both individual presence and platform recognition.
strategic_value: Spotify for Artists can signal a related service through its extended lockup without making the portrait look like a product screenshot.
demonstration: Two close portraits fill a yellow-to-blue gradient field crossed by thin orange diagonal linework; the service lockup sits at lower right.
practical_value: Compare a natural-color portrait treatment with the duotone examples in this collection.

content_islands.spec: One face leans in from upper left; a second figure with reflective glasses occupies the right.

content_islands.spec: Orange diagonals cross the portraits and pastel background.
